> 第724章 夜晚降临（第1页）
白日天光压制了杂念与浊气，也掩盖了秘境真正的凶险，谁都清楚，今夜的异兽攻势，必然远超昨夜。
暮色彻底吞没孤城最后一缕微光，整片天地骤然坠入死寂的浓黑。
白日里被天光压制的虚空浊气，于夜色降临的刹那瞬间复苏、暴涨，如同潮水般漫过整座城墙。
方才尚且克制、理智的各族修士，心底瞬间涌上莫名的焦躁、猜忌与戾气，只是白日盟约尚在心头，众人强行压下杂念，握紧手中兵刃，凝神戒备城外异动。
下一刻，远方虚空裂隙剧烈翻滚涌动，不再是昨夜零散、平缓的兽潮冲刷，而是铺天盖地的黑色兽浪轰然涌出。
密密麻麻的虚空异兽遮蔽视野，枯槁扭曲的躯体层层叠叠，漆黑爪牙泛着腐蚀寒芒，嘶哑空洞的嘶吼震得城墙砖石微微震颤。
四门之上，各族修士瞬间全力出手。
得益于白日定下的互助监督盟约，此刻的孤城再也没有昨夜的敷衍与内耗。
东门人族修士灵力奔腾，术法漫天铺开，火海、风刃、雷纹交织成致密的杀伤网，死死挡住正面扑来的兽潮。
战场之上，多族配合的画面随处可见，默契尽显。
有人族修士催动燎原烈火焚烧成片攀墙异兽，火势凶猛却难免遗漏缝隙，旁侧值守的草木精怪即刻催动万千柔韧藤根，锁住逃窜的残血异兽，将其死死缚在墙头火海之中，任由烈焰焚灭，杜绝一丝漏网之敌。
偶尔有身形迅捷的高阶异兽冲破火网、直扑城头，人族修士来不及二次结印，边角值守的灵体便瞬间凝出草木韧盾格挡，顿挫异兽冲势的刹那，人族雷法瞬至，惊雷贯体，瞬间炸碎异兽暗影躯体。
一旦有修士被入夜浊气侵扰、心神晃动出现破绽，身旁同伴立刻及时补位，跨种族的巡查修士即刻出声警示、当场约束。
慕星云四人混在人族主力之中，结出四方固杀阵，专斩突破防线的漏网高阶异兽，稳守人族核心防线。
藤皇潜藏墙体缝隙，舒展漫天青碧藤蔓，一边绞杀异兽，一边散发温润草木清气，中和局部浓郁浊气，护住心神最易失守的灵体一族，为人族、灵体的持续联动保驾护航。
北门更是将妖魔联防的优势发挥得淋漓尽致，彻底褪去昨夜互相提防的僵局。
妖族修士肉身强横、近战无敌，成群妖修扑至墙头边缘，利爪横扫，硬生生拍碎层层叠叠扑来的异兽躯体，凭借肉身优势死死顶住正面兽潮压力。
但妖术覆盖范围有限，外墙死角极易藏敌，值守侧翼的魔族修士便精准补位，抬手凝出漆黑魔罡，远程清扫墙面死角，将妖族疏漏的异兽尽数绞杀。

更有精妙配合转瞬即逝：一头体型硕大的异兽头领顶着妖力冲击强行登城，妖族长老纵身近身缠斗，死死锁住其四肢，却被异兽腐蚀黑雾缠身、难以脱身。后侧魔族修士当即舍弃远程输出，凝出凝实魔刃，精准避开妖族躯体，一刀贯穿异兽头颅暗影核心，干净利落斩杀强敌，全程配合毫无滞涩。

> Chapter 724 Night falls (page 1)
The daylight suppressed distracting thoughts and turbidity, and also concealed the true danger of the secret realm. Everyone knew that the attack of alien beasts tonight would be far greater than last night.
The twilight completely swallowed up the last glimmer of light in the lonely city, and the entire world suddenly fell into a deathly darkness.
The turbid air in the void that was suppressed by the skylight during the day instantly revived and surged when night fell, overflowing the entire city wall like a tide.
The monks of all races who were restrained and rational just now suddenly felt inexplicable anxiety, suspicion and hostility in their hearts. However, the day's covenant was still in their hearts. They suppressed their distracting thoughts, clenched their weapons, and concentrated on guarding against any unusual movements outside the city.
The next moment, the cracks in the void in the distance rolled and surged violently. It was no longer the scattered and gentle tide of beasts last night, but the overwhelming black waves of beasts surged out.
Densely packed void beasts obscured the field of vision, withered and twisted bodies piled on top of one another, the black claws glowed with a corrosive cold light, and the hoarse and hollow roars shook the masonry of the city wall slightly.
Above the four gates, monks from all races immediately took action with all their strength.
Thanks to the mutual cooperation and supervision agreement established during the day, the isolated city no longer had the perfunctory and internal friction of last night.
The human monks from the East Gate surged with spiritual power, spreading their spells all over the sky. The sea of ​​fire, wind blades, and thunder patterns intertwined into a dense killing net, blocking the tide of beasts coming from the front.
On the battlefield, scenes of multi-ethnic cooperation can be seen everywhere, showing a tacit understanding.
The human monks activated the prairie fire to burn the alien beasts climbing up the wall. The fire was fierce, but it was inevitable that gaps would be missed. The plant and tree monsters on duty immediately mobilized thousands of flexible vine roots to lock the escaped alien beasts with residual blood, and tied them to the sea of ​​​​fire on the wall, allowing them to be burned by the flames, preventing any enemies from slipping through the net.
Occasionally, a fast and high-level alien beast breaks through the fire net and rushes towards the city. The human monks have no time to form a second seal, and the spirit bodies on guard at the corner instantly form a tough shield of grass and trees to block it. The moment the alien beast's momentum is thwarted, the human thunder spell arrives instantly, thunder pierces the body, and instantly explodes the shadow body of the alien beast.
Once a monk is disturbed by the turbid night air and his mind wanders, his companions will immediately take over his place, and cross-racial patrolling monks will immediately sound a warning and restrain them on the spot.
The four of Mu Xingyun mingled with the main force of the human race and formed a four-sided solid killing formation, specializing in killing high-level alien beasts that slipped through the defense line and firmly guarding the core defense line of the human race.
The Vine King hides in the cracks in the wall and stretches the green vines all over the sky. While strangling the strange beasts, it exudes the warm fresh air of grass and trees, neutralizes the strong turbid air in some places, protects the spirit clan that is most vulnerable to losing its mind, and protects the continuous linkage between humans and spirits.
The North Gate took full advantage of the Demons' joint defense, completely eliminating the deadlock of being wary of each other last night.
The demon monks are physically powerful and invincible in close combat. Groups of demon cultivators rushed to the edge of the wall, sweeping their sharp claws and smashing the bodies of the alien beasts that were coming one after another. They relied on their physical advantages to withstand the pressure of the frontal beast tide.
However, the coverage of the magic is limited, and it is easy to hide enemies in the blind corners of the outer wall. The demon monks guarding the flanks accurately filled their positions, raised their hands to condense the dark magic aura, and remotely cleared the blind corners of the wall, strangling all the strange beasts that the demon clan had missed.
There was even more exquisite coordination that was fleeting: a huge alien beast leader forced his way onto the city despite the impact of demon power. The elders of the demon clan jumped into a close fight and locked their limbs tightly, but they were corroded by the alien beast and wrapped in black mist, making it difficult to escape. The demon monk at the back immediately gave up the long-range output, condensed the solid demon blade, accurately avoided the demon body, and penetrated the shadow core of the alien beast's head with one knife, killing the powerful enemy cleanly and without hesitation in the whole process.
